# airflow_fab_user (Resource)

An Airflow FAB user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airflow_fab_user" "test" {
  username   = "troubleshoot_user"
  password   = "TempPass123!!"
  email      = "troubleshoot@example.com"
  first_name = "Troubleshoot"
  last_name  = "User"
  roles      = ["User"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) User's email.
- `first_name` (String) User's first name.
- `last_name` (String) User's last name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User authentication secret for dashboard login and api token generation.
- `roles` (Set of String) Set of user's role. Note that because changing a role's permission causes a recreation and this field is evaluate for reconciliation during the plan phase, changing a role's permission and assigning it to a user in the same terraform apply will cause the user to temporarily lose the role until another terraform apply is performed.
- `username` (String) User id for dashboard login and api token generation.
